items.text: In Fars province, the death sentences of three prisoners were carried out in Adelabad prison in Shiraz. Two of them were convicted of drug-related crimes and one for murder. Additionally, another prisoner previously sentenced to death for murder was spared after the victim's family pardoned him.

A worker in Mashhad died after falling from the scaffolding of a building under construction. The incident occurred due to lack of safety and poor working conditions. More details are published by Harana News Agency.

The mother of Amirhossein Emamjomeh placed 9 apples in a dish on the ninth month after his killing. She said she nurtured him in her womb for 9 months and now has lost him for 9 months. Amirhossein Emamjomeh was killed on January 8, 2026, in the Haft-Hoz area of Tehran.

In the past week, combating illegal hunting, air pollution, water resource depletion, and land subsidence were the main environmental issues in Iran. The report is based on 68 news items published by media and local authorities. It also includes wildlife rescue and actions against environmental offenders.

Alireza Beiranvand, the goalkeeper of Tractor team, was expelled from the team's camp due to his criticism of the club's managers and his interview against them. The Tractor club announced that this decision was made by Javad Nekounam due to false statements and creating controversy. Beiranvand was handed over to the club's disciplinary committee.

Donald Trump announced that the US has full control over the Strait of Hormuz and has agreed with Russia to supply millions of tons of diesel to the global market. According to him, Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel and deliver another 500,000 tons in November. This move will quickly reduce diesel prices.

Khosrow Karam-Pouri and Shirzad Chavoshini, two citizens of Baneh, were arrested by intelligence officers. Shirzad Chavoshini was transferred to a detention center in Sanandaj. The location of Khosrow Karam-Pouri's detention is still unknown.

Human rights activists in Iran released their annual report showing that at least 2,003 people were executed in the past year. This figure represents a 29% increase compared to the previous year. Among the executions, 69 were related to political and security charges, and 47 women and four juvenile offenders were executed.

A group of Iranians residing in Malmo, Sweden, held a Mehregan celebration on Friday, October 9. The mother of Majid Adineh, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, attended the event. Majid Adineh was executed on August 22, 2026, in Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj.

Mehdi Taj stated that Amir Ghalenoei's contract with the national football team is 50 billion tomans annually until the World Cup. Taj denied the 90 billion tomans figure for the Asian Cup and said no specific amount was written in Ghalenoei's contract. Earlier, there was a report about Ghalenoei requesting 90 billion tomans as salary.

Abu Reyhan pharmaceutical company in Tehran has not paid workers' and contractors' wages. The price of the Samsung A54 mobile phone has risen from 50 million to 120 million tomans. Medical staff in Birjand have not received their salaries and benefits for one year.

Donald Trump said that if Iran obtained nuclear weapons, it might target European countries after attacking Israel and other parts of the Middle East. He also stated that the Islamic Republic could target cities like Los Angeles and San Diego in the United States.

Ahmad Gohari, a player of Sanat Naft Abadan, said that Saeed Daghighi, the former coach of Peykan, believed in magic. He stated that when the team lost, Daghighi said the team was bewitched. These remarks were made after the match against Persepolis.

Mohammad Fateh was injured on January 8, 2026, in Alvand, Qazvin province, by forces of the Islamic Republic and fell into a coma. He died after 10 days in the hospital. His mother is seen in a video expressing grief and condemning those who took him away.

Human rights activists reported that 2,003 people were executed in Iran over the past year. At least 69 of those executed faced political and security charges. The wave of executions is part of suppressing the December protests and aims to deter and intimidate society.
Alireza Beiranvand criticized the managers of Tractor after the match against Esteghlal. His statements provoked a reaction from the club managers. Eventually, he was expelled from the Tractor team.

The match between Tractor and Esteghlal in the eighth week of the Premier League ended in a 1-1 draw. The game had many controversies, and both teams needed three points but did not achieve them. Discussions about the match took place in the Hat-trick program.

Arash Aramesh criticized Donald Trump's policy towards the Islamic Republic as unpredictable and lacking strategic coherence. He said Trump both increases pressure on the Islamic Republic and financially supports Tehran by buying fuel from Russia. Aramesh emphasized that US national security should not be sacrificed for electoral considerations.

Mohammed Al-Jaber, Saudi Arabia's ambassador to Yemen, stated that Bab al-Mandab has been cleared of Houthi terrorist militants. The spokesperson for Yemen's government forces confirmed that after securing Bab al-Mandab, southern forces launched an attack on a Houthi base in Dhubab. These forces are currently clearing the area.

Leila Morvati said European countries have so far taken a limited and defensive approach to the Yemen crisis, only conducting escort missions for ships. She added that if Houthi attacks on European interests expand, Europe may need to cooperate more actively with the US. Military cooperation between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey could increase the likelihood of Houthi withdrawal.

The military service organization has informed Alireza Beiranvand that he is not allowed to leave the country until his medical commission status is determined. Beiranvand was expelled from Tractor club after criticizing its managers and is not allowed to attend the team's camp or hotel. He has participated in the psychiatric medical commission in Tabriz and undergone medical tests for military exemption.

Shahad Alavi from Iran International stated that the Islamic Republic uses executions to counter legitimacy crises and create fear. In the past year, 2,003 people have been executed in Iran, with an increase in political prisoner executions. He emphasized that stopping executions requires the will of the international community, which has not yet been seen.

Mohammad Taghavi analyzed the Tractor vs Esteghlal match in the Hat-trick program. He said the first half was dominated by Esteghlal and the second half by Tractor. According to him, a draw was a fair result for both teams.

The judiciary of the Islamic Republic has sentenced more than 10 specialized workers of Petropars in Howeyzeh to flogging and fines for demanding labor rights. These workers faced security and judicial actions after protesting dismissals and replacement with non-local forces. The Karun Human Rights Organization considers the flogging sentence a violation of human rights.

Siamak Aram stated that the isolation of the Islamic Republic is a factual reality and Tehran has no serious allies among neighboring countries. He added that economic and military pressures against Iran continue, and after a new military confrontation, a weaker agreement may be reached. Donald Trump's positions may change, but behind-the-scenes talks continue.

Iran International's investigation shows that Parsian Bank used its subsidiary exchange to transfer millions of dollars abroad. Internal correspondences from November 2022 to June 2023 confirm this. These transfers were signed by the bank's international affairs manager.

The 49th match between Persepolis and Sanat Naft Abadan ended with a 3-1 victory for Persepolis. Mehdi Tartars' team had chances to score more goals. The match was covered in the Hat-Trick program with interviews by Mazdak Mirzaei.

Donald Trump announced that Katie Zakaria, senior communications advisor at Truth Social, has been appointed as White House spokesperson. Trump described Zakaria's performance at Truth Social as outstanding. Zakaria is a lawyer and media analyst who has participated in Trump's election campaigns.

Donald Trump, the former US President, has asked the Supreme Court to reopen his lawsuit against Hillary Clinton, his Democratic rival in the 2016 presidential election. Trump has accused Clinton of conspiring to manipulate the outcome of the 2016 election by linking his campaign to Russia. He filed this lawsuit in 2022 against Clinton, James Comey, and several others.

Zelensky described Trump's decision to lift sanctions on Russia and allow diesel exports as unfair and dishonest. He called the move a gift to Putin and said the US did not mention any diesel agreement in recent talks. He also stated that Ukrainian negotiators were informed of Trump's intention to talk with Putin one hour before Trump's announcement.

Trump said he prevented Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons and blowing up the Middle East. He emphasized that Iran's fate will be determined soon: either they give the US what it wants or they will not exist. He added that issues with Russia, Ukraine, and Iran are progressing rapidly.

Trump criticized the Nobel Committee for not awarding him the Peace Prize, calling it a stain on Norway's reputation. The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2026 Peace Prize to Navanethem Pillay, former UN High Commissioner for Human Rights. Following this announcement, Trump sanctioned the International Criminal Court.

Donald Trump stated that if the Islamic Republic had acquired nuclear weapons, it might have targeted beyond Israel and other Middle Eastern countries, Europe, and American cities including Los Angeles and San Diego.

The oil agreement between the US and Russia and the discovery of alternative energy routes have reduced the importance of the Strait of Hormuz as a leverage tool for the Islamic Republic. Increased attacks by the Islamic Republic on ships may be an attempt to compensate for this reduced pressure. If Tehran does not accept Washington's demands, the likelihood of US military action against Iran's nuclear targets increases.

Houthi-affiliated media reported a missile attack on Saada city and the communication network of Al-Safra district. These two cities are in areas controlled by the group in northern Yemen. The Saudi-led coalition released images of Houthis fleeing during a clearing operation in Bab al-Mandeb.

The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime reported that the Islamic Republic has increasingly relied on the illegal economy to counter US sanctions. The report mentions the expansion of poppy cultivation in Sistan and Baluchestan and the possible production of Captagon. It also highlights the IRGC's revenue from drug trafficking.

Houshang Hasan-Yari stated that the number of missiles launched by the Islamic Republic has decreased. He emphasized that US and Israeli attacks have weakened the missile and drone capabilities of the Islamic Republic. There is also a possibility of resumption of military conflict among these parties.

The 78th Frankfurt International Book Fair is being held with the participation of thousands of publishers, authors, and cultural activists. This year, the absence of the Islamic Republic and the unveiling of a book about the justice-seeking of Ukrainian flight victims are notable topics. The report is by Mehdi Tehrani for Iran International.

Bloomberg reported, citing a Western official, that Russia is supplying missiles to Iran. The Islamic Republic has maintained its missile and drone production facilities and has significant ballistic missile stockpiles. It is also reported that Iran has added newly made Russian weapons to its arsenal.
A citizen criticized the price increase of the Rectol ointment in a video sent to Iran International. He asked what is happening to the people. The video reflects concerns about rising drug prices.

The situation in Karaj and Tehran has become highly secure, with law enforcement controlling young people. In Tehran's District 18, military forces have occupied part of a schoolyard. Additionally, armed police officers visited a school in Semnan and behaved threateningly.

Mahmoud Beheshti Langroudi, a teachers' union activist, was summoned to the third investigative branch of the public and revolutionary prosecutor's office in Langroud. The summons was issued through an official notification.

Shahram Khaledi said Donald Trump is seeking an opportunity to force the Islamic Republic to accept his demands. He also stated that Russia is moving in a path detrimental to the Islamic Republic. These remarks concern international relations and regional policies.

Mahshad Keshani, a political prisoner and wife of Alireza Sepahi, is under intense interrogation in Dolatabad prison in Isfahan, and her contact with the outside has been cut off. The families of Keshani and Sepahi are also under pressure to deny their marriage. The head of the women's section of Dolatabad prison has been accused of putting pressure on Keshani.
